hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case " $cmd" in *" gh "*|*" gh") acct=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]+user:' "$HOME/.config/gh/hosts.yml" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}'); [ "$acct" = "Palissp" ] || { echo "BLOQUEADO: la cuenta gh activa es '${acct:-desconocida}', este repo es personal (Palissp). Ejecuta: gh auth switch --user Palissp" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
